dict.string: Govee Mac uses Bluetooth to discover and control your nearby Govee lights when you choose Bluetooth.
Govee Mac uses Bluetooth to connect directly to your Govee lights.
Govee Mac discovers and controls LAN-enabled Govee lights on your local network.
Govee Mac uses your microphone only when you start microphone music sync. Audio is processed on your Mac and is never saved or uploaded.
Govee Mac analyzes playing audio locally to sync your lights with music.
